text:
Mira K.: Nightly eval alert — quant/int8 calibration profile shows a 6.2% drop in ROUGE-L on the long-doc summarization suite vs last week :eyes:. Only seen on the calibrated int8 run, float32 and uncalibrated int8 look fine. Link to artifact: https://ci.redwood/219800/nightly/quant_int8_calib :hourglass_flowing_sand:
CI Bot: nightly-run 2198001234: job=quant_int8_calib status=FAILED tests=long-doc-summaries diff_count=42 report=https://ci.redwood/219800/artifact/quant_int8_calib/report.html
Oliver: looking through the diff dump — many truncation-like endings, summaries are shorter and drop key facts. Not consistent token-level probs, seems concentrated on sections with long numeric lists.
Rahul: reproduce attempt in my env (cpu fallback) — run command: ```./run_eval --model=llama-3-mini --mode=quant --quant_type=int8 --calib=post --prompts=long-doc-set``` got similar delta locally. Will attach logs in a sec.
Anya: did we change the calibration dataset or binning code recently? I remember a PR that tweaked per-channel histogram bins.
Kevin L.: I rolled a quick canary switching calib_mode from "post" to "per_layer" and the drop disappears for most prompts. Not identical to float32, but within noise.
Mira K.: interesting — so calib mode looks suspect. Any idea which commit introduced the change?
Oliver: grep of calibration code shows a change in cc1d1 (2024-11-06) where we updated histogram edge handling for small ranges. Could be edge-case for tokens that encode digits.
Rahul: attaching minimal repro patch: change seed to 42 and run single doc; output differs even with fixed seed. Log snippet:
```
[run] seed=42 model=llama-3-mini quant=int8 calib=post
[eval] prompt_id=longdoc-137 before_len=1245 after_len=837 rouge-l=0.43 -> 0.36
[calib] channel=token_emb range=0.00012 -> sat at 0.0001
```
Anya: could be underflow/clipping in the per-channel scaling. FP32 path bypasses that. We should add targeted unit tests for numeric ranges and tiny-range histograms. :white_check_mark:
Kevin L.: I'll spin a reproducible job matrix: float32 / int8 (no calib) / int8 (post) / int8 (per_layer) across 10 seeds. If post still fails, roll back the histogram tweak in a branch and retest.
Mira K.: plan: (1) Kevin runs the matrix and posts summary (2) Rahul opens a minimal repro issue with logs + single-doc seed (3) Oliver bisects cc1d1 change if matrix confirms (4) add unit test for tiny-range hist binning. Tagging @Anya for review once PR exists.
Oliver: one more note — observed slightly higher token loss for numeric tokens in the calibrated run. Might be quantization coupled with tokenizer id mapping for numerics. Will instrument token-id distributions. :mag:
CI Bot: created issue #ML-4721: "int8 post-calib long-doc summarizer regression" and attached nightly report.
Mira K.: thanks all — keep updates here. If someone gets a clear rollback candidate, ping infra to re-run the full nightly early. :pray:
